title: Microsoft SharePoint: SharePoint Server access through the mobile apps will be retired
summary: SharePoint Server access via the standalone SharePoint mobile apps for iOS and Android will be retired starting November 27, 2026. These apps will support SharePoint Online only. Organizations should notify users and update documentation accordingly before this change.
body:
[What and why]

Microsoft is retiring SharePoint Server access through the standalone SharePoint mobile apps for iOS and Android. After this change, these apps will support SharePoint Online only.

[Rollout schedule]

- Retirement (Worldwide, GCC, GCC High, DoD): Beginning November 27, 2026[Impact on your organization]

Who is affected

- Organizations with users who access SharePoint Server through the SharePoint mobile apps for iOS or AndroidPlatforms and services

- SharePoint mobile apps for iOS and Android- SharePoint ServerWhat will happen

- Users will no longer be able to access SharePoint Server through the standalone SharePoint mobile apps for iOS or Android.- The SharePoint mobile apps will support SharePoint Online only.[Action required and recommendations]

Before this change takes effect:

- Notify users who access SharePoint Server through the SharePoint mobile apps that this access is being retired.- Update your internal documentation and support materials as appropriate.Learn more

- About SharePoint mobile app | Microsoft Support- SharePoint mobile app for Android | Microsoft Support[Compliance considerations]

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.

[What and why]

Microsoft is retiring SharePoint Server access through the standalone SharePoint mobile apps for iOS and Android. After this change, these apps will support SharePoint Online only.

[Rollout schedule]

  • Retirement (Worldwide, GCC, GCC High, DoD): Beginning November 27, 2026

[Impact on your organization]

Who is affected

  • Organizations with users who access SharePoint Server through the SharePoint mobile apps for iOS or Android

Platforms and services

  • SharePoint mobile apps for iOS and Android
  • SharePoint Server

What will happen

  • Users will no longer be able to access SharePoint Server through the standalone SharePoint mobile apps for iOS or Android.
  • The SharePoint mobile apps will support SharePoint Online only.

[Action required and recommendations]

Before this change takes effect:

  • Notify users who access SharePoint Server through the SharePoint mobile apps that this access is being retired.
  • Update your internal documentation and support materials as appropriate.
